title: Streaming overtook cable in US living rooms around 2022
intro: Share of US television viewing time, by delivery. Streaming's slice climbed past cable's for the first time in mid-2022 and kept rising, while cable's long decline continued.

source.name: Nielsen The Gauge, US TV viewing share

altInsight: Cable's share of US TV viewing fell from 62% in 2010 to 28% in 2025, while streaming rose from 4% to 41%, overtaking cable around 2022.
